description: This file is a FastAPI router module implementing authentication endpoints, including login, current user retrieval, and Solana blockchain-related signature verification. It defines API routes, handles token extraction, user authentication, and interacts with security, database, and Solana services.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User ORM model representing user data in the database.

classes.name: UserRead
classes.description: Schema for returning user profile data.

methods.name: str _extract_token_from_header(authorization: Optional[str])
methods.description: Extracts and validates bearer token from Authorization header.

methods.name: User get_current_user( db: Session = Depends(get_db), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None), )
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user based on JWT token.

methods.name: Token login(data: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db), settings=Depends(get_config))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns JWT token.

methods.name: UserRead me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns profile information of the current user.

methods.name: dict solana_message(address: str)
methods.description: Generates a message and nonce for Solana wallet signing.

methods.name: dict solana_verify(payload: dict)
methods.description: Verifies a Solana signature for authentication.

ctags.name: get_current_user
ctags.signature: ( db: Session = Depends(get_db), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None), )

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(data: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db), settings=Depends(get_config)) -> Token/
